request.message: Bhai meri bakery ki photo din mein li thi, lekin andar ka area dark aa raha hai aur bahar ki sunlight bahut bright hai. Google Flow mein lighting fix karta hoon toh cake display aur shop ke colours bhi change ho jaate hain. Mujhe original bakery same rakhni hai, bas photo professional banani hai. Kya karu? Ek exact prompt bhi de do.

history.content: Ask anything from your indexed courses. I can search across all course lessons.

Create a general Instagram poster prompt in English for Chai Junction in Vijay Nagar, Indore. We sell chai, Maggi and sandwiches. Use the real shop photo and preserve the actual shop identity and signboard. Include the supplied products. No festival themes, discounts, offers, prices or unsupported promotional claims. Return only the ready-to-use English poster prompt.

Here is a general Instagram poster prompt for Chai Junction:

"Create an Instagram poster for Chai Junction in Vijay Nagar, Indore. Use the provided real shop photo, ensuring the shop's identity and signboard are preserved. The poster should highlight that we serve chai, Maggi, and sandwiches. The tone should be general and inviting, without any festival themes, discounts, offers, prices, or unsupported promotional claims."

response.answer:
Approved exact prompt:

```text
Turn this phone photo of my [shop] into a professional interior photograph, like one shot
by a good photographer for Instagram and Google Maps. Keep the same room, same furniture,
same counter, same boards and same layout — do not add or remove any furniture.
Make these improvements boldly:
- Lighting: replace the harsh tube-light look with warm, soft, inviting light
- Colours: rich and warm, clean walls, natural shine on surfaces
- Camera: straighten the photo, fix the tilt and the stretched wide-angle look, frame it
at normal eye level
- Clean-up: tables wiped clean, chairs neatly pushed in, floor clean, remove clutter,
wires and stains
- Quality: sharp focus, no grain, natural depth, looks like a real DSLR photo
No people, no new decorations, no plants, no text added. Realistic, not AI-looking.
```
